title: Fix Copy and Paste Story Windows Not Showing
description: The CopyAndPaste.stories.tsx defines a custom LAYOUT using `id` and `label` on window nodes, but UIWindowLayoutWindowNode requires `windowKindId` (not `id`). The `convertWindowLayoutNodeToGoldenConfig` function reads `child.windowKindId` to set the GoldenLayout `componentName`, so when `id` is used instead, all componentNames are `undefined` and no windows render. Fix: update LAYOUT to use `windowKindId` instead of `id` on all window nodes.
